name: open_curriculum
description: Open a primary-school lesson or find curriculum content. Use for class, subject, chapter, lesson, textbook, explanation, or study requests.

name: explain_again
description: Explain the current verified answer again. Use when the learner says they did not understand or asks for an easier, shorter, step-by-step, example, Bangla, English, or Banglish explanation.

name: start_quiz
description: Start a quiz or practice questions for the current or requested class, subject, or lesson.

name: open_parent_guide
description: Open verified guidance for a parent helping a child study at home.

name: open_teacher_guide
description: Open verified lesson-planning, classroom, assessment, or teaching guidance for a teacher.

name: save_note
description: Save the current answer or learner text as a note.

name: ask_general_online
description: Route a non-curriculum open-world or current-information question to the online tutor. Do not use for a textbook or verified curriculum question.
